name: Kasmiatun.et.al_EFForTS.Beetles_N.BL.BW.TBM
description: Collated total abundance, average per sqm, average body length, average body width, and total live biomass of overall Coleoptera as well as Chrysomelidae, Curculionidae, Elateridae and Staphylinidae per EFForTS core plot in Dry Season and Rainy Season 2013/14. Overall Coleoptera contains data on the four families already.

citation.name: Kasmiatun, Tamara R. Hartke, Damayanti Buchori, Purnama Hidayat, Fatimah Siddikah, Rosyid Amrulloh, Muhammad Syaifullah Hiola, Lailatun Najmi, Woro Anggraitoningsih, Stefan Scheu and Jochen Drescher. Contrasting effects of land-use change on four beetle families on Sumatra, Indonesia. in prep.
